modules.title: Start the app and connect the files
modules.job: Starts Flutter with Tidal2WiiMApp. Builds MaterialApp, a dark theme and HomePage. Combines 16 part files into one shared Dart library and imports two other project libraries.
modules.inputs: Optional: bibliothekLaden callback and TidalAuthService for isolated tests.
modules.outputs: Widget tree with HomePage; does not itself provide album data or run SQL queries.
modules.partners: Includes all part files; imports models/kuenstler_sortierung.dart and services/tidal_auth_service.dart.
modules.lesson: The folders represent functional areas. Technically, tidal2wiim is a Dart package with three project libraries.

modules.title: Process JSON, search text and durations
modules.job: Provides small helper functions with no state of their own. Checks JSON structures, cleans up text and converts ISO durations for the track display.
modules.inputs: Object?, JSON values, search text or Duration?.
modules.outputs: Json, List<Json>, String?, normalised search text, as well as Duration? and display text.
modules.partners: Used by models, API response processing, the collection and the album detail page. No direct network or database access.
modules.lesson: A missing optional value may remain null. An invalid required structure, however, is reported as a FormatException.
modules.type_note: `String?` means text or `null`. `Duration?` means a duration or `null`. In each case, the `?` allows a missing value.

modules.title: Derive views from existing albums
modules.job: Filters and sorts albums, creates artist folders and calculates the A–Z jump index. Defines the selection values for the app page, collection view and sorting.
modules.inputs: List<Album>, search text, Sortierung and Map<String, KuenstlerEinstellung>.
modules.outputs: Filtered album list, List<KuenstlerOrdner> or Map<String, int> as a letter index.
modules.partners: HomePage calls the functions when building the collection. Uses domain models and text helpers.
modules.lesson: Artist folders are created in RAM. Multiple artists on one album result in multiple folder assignments. Album sorting uses TIDAL artist names; custom sort names control the artist folders.

modules.title: Describe shared data objects
modules.job: Defines eight domain and data transfer models for albums, artists, categories, settings, tracks, folders, API pages and the local cache. Album.ausRessourcen() combines API resources into an album.
modules.inputs: Constructor values; resource index keyed by type:id; SQLite map for KuenstlerEinstellung.
modules.outputs: Typed Dart objects; derived values such as year, display name and album count.
modules.partners: Shared vocabulary for HomePage, detail pages, SQLite, the collection and cover display.
modules.symbols: Album, Kuenstler, Kategorie, KuenstlerEinstellung, KuenstlerOrdner, AlbumTitel, AlbumSeite, LokaleBibliothekCache
modules.lesson: Kategorie holds album IDs. Album contains artists, but no track list. A final field does not automatically make a list referenced by that field immutable.

modules.title: Collect changes in a draft
modules.job: Manages the original rows and sort names that have not yet been saved. Detects actual changes and keeps the order and the basis for searching stable while typing.
modules.inputs: Iterable<KuenstlerSortierZeile>; artist ID and input text; search text.
modules.outputs: Filtered rows, change count and an immutable List<KuenstlerSortierAenderung>.
modules.partners: Independent library with no imports from Flutter, SQLite or TIDAL. The editor page uses it; dedicated unit tests check the logic.
modules.symbols: KuenstlerSortierZeile, KuenstlerSortierAenderung, KuenstlerSortierEntwurf; setzen(), filtern(), aenderungen
modules.lesson: Raw text is retained while typing. Only the effective value to be saved is trimmed; an empty field falls back to the original TIDAL name.

modules.title: Store structured data locally
modules.job: Opens tidal2wiim.db with schema 3 and enables foreign keys. Encapsulates the cache, artist preferences, categories and album assignments; handles migrations and transactions.
modules.inputs: Album lists with timestamps, KuenstlerEinstellung, category names, and album and category IDs.
modules.outputs: Future<LokaleBibliothekCache?>, settings map, category lists, sets of IDs or Future<void>.
modules.partners: HomePage, KategoriePage and AlbumDetailPage use LokaleDatenbank.instance. sqflite executes SQL; path constructs the file path.
modules.lesson: Cache replacement and assignment changes are atomic. Only category_albums.category_id is an SQL foreign key; artist data is stored in the cache as JSON.

modules.title: Write sort names to SQLite in one batch
modules.job: Adds batch saving to LokaleDatenbank. Checks IDs in advance and performs all changes in a single transaction. Does not modify existing custom display names.
modules.outputs: Future<void>; on errors, an Exception and rollback rather than a partially applied set of changes.
modules.partners: HomePage connects the extension method to the editor page as the onSpeichern callback. Writes to artist_preferences.
modules.lesson: An extension is not a subclass. When resetting, a preference record is only deleted if no custom display name needs to be retained.

modules.title: Manage login and the token lifecycle
modules.job: Restores the shared session, saves login results and renews tokens when needed. Prevents duplicate concurrent refreshes and results from a session that has since been replaced.
modules.inputs: clientId, optional store/client/clock dependencies; TidalSession at login; HTTPS URI and HTTP client when reading.
modules.outputs: Future<String> for a token, Future<Response> for an API GET, status getters and ChangeNotifier notifications.
modules.partners: HomePage owns or receives the service and passes the same reference to subpages. SecureTidalSessionStore uses flutter_secure_storage.
modules.symbols: TidalAuthService, TidalSession, TidalSessionStore, SecureTidalSessionStore; restore(), acceptLogin(), accessToken(), get(), forget()
modules.lesson: HTTP 401 leads to at most one second API GET. Temporary network errors preserve the session. storageWarning indicates problems reading, saving or removing the securely stored session.

modules.title: Standardise API calls and read JSON
modules.job: Builds OpenAPI URLs, calls the authentication service, checks for HTTP 200 and decodes JSON. Reads the next-page cursor, selects a suitable cover URL and translates errors into understandable messages.
modules.inputs: http.Client, shared TidalAuthService, path segments and query parameters; JSON resources for the cover and cursor.
modules.outputs: Future<Json>, String? for a cursor/cover URL, or ApiFehler.
modules.partners: HomePage and AlbumDetailPage use _apiLesen(). Album.ausRessourcen() uses _coverUrlLesen().
modules.lesson: The file is mainly a collection of functions, not a TidalApi class. Each call waits 300 ms before the request; this is not a complete automatic retry mechanism for HTTP 429.

modules.title: Cache album covers as files
modules.job: Finds or downloads cover files in the local cover_cache directory. Combines ongoing downloads for the same target path, initially writes to .tmp and removes obsolete files during synchronisation.
modules.inputs: Album with an ID and cover URL, or List<Album> for preloading; optional HTTP client.
modules.outputs: Future<File?> for a cover, or Future<void> after synchronisieren().
modules.partners: AlbumCover requests individual files. HomePage starts preloading after accepting the cache or completing a full update.
modules.lesson: The limit of up to four workers applies to synchronisieren(), rather than being a global limit on all individual requests. Image bytes are stored in the file system and never as BLOBs in SQLite.

modules.title: Coordinate app state and workflows
modules.job: The central StatefulWidget HomePage and its state _HomePageState manage the start view, lab and collection. They coordinate login, the cache, API pages, background synchronisation, search, artist folders, categories and navigation to the sort-name editor.
modules.inputs: Optional test dependencies, user actions, service notifications, API and database results.
modules.outputs: Current UI state; data and AuthService passed to child pages; callbacks for reloading.
modules.partners: The central coordinator for the database, authentication, API and cover cache. Builds StartPage; opens artist, category, album and editor pages.
modules.lesson: Splitting the code into files does not yet separate all UI and domain logic. The lab and collection are widget methods here, rather than separate page classes.

modules.title: Connect the start image to real controls
modules.job: Displays the start graphic, dynamic album count and status bar. Scales the image, text and touch target areas together and triggers four actions supplied by the parent widget.
modules.inputs: Album count, session/loading flags, update time and four callbacks.
modules.outputs: Calls to onSammlungOeffnen, onLaborOeffnen, onAktualisieren and onTidalStatus.
modules.partners: Configured by HomePage. _StartAktion, _StartStatusLeiste and two CustomPainter implementations form internal UI components.
modules.lesson: StartPage does not read SQLite or the API itself. It displays the supplied state and delegates actions back to HomePage.

modules.title: Display an album, its tracks and local assignments
modules.job: Loads the track list from TIDAL and categories from SQLite independently of each other. Allows category assignment and opens album, track or video links externally.
modules.inputs: Album, shared AuthService, optional country and callbacks for login and category changes.
modules.outputs: List<AlbumTitel> in the page state, local category selection and external URLs; feedback after an assignment is saved.
modules.partners: Opened by HomePage or AlbumGrid; uses _apiLesen(), LokaleDatenbank, AlbumCover and dialogs.
modules.lesson: The track list is not cached persistently. launchUrl() starts an external handler; playback and WiiM selection then take place outside our app.

modules.title: Display the albums in an artist folder
modules.job: A small, stateless wrapper: displays the display name as the page title and passes the associated albums to AlbumGrid.
modules.inputs: KuenstlerOrdner, AuthService, optional country and change/login callbacks.
modules.outputs: Widget tree consisting of AppBar and AlbumGrid.
modules.partners: HomePage creates the folder beforehand with _kuenstlerOrdnerErstellen(). AlbumGrid handles navigation to the details.
modules.lesson: The page does not create folders or request artist data. It receives objects that have already been prepared.

modules.title: Connect saved assignments to loaded albums
modules.job: Reads the category together with its album IDs and filters the supplied album list. Displays both the visible albums and the number of saved assignments.
modules.inputs: Category ID/name, all currently loaded albums, AuthService and callbacks.
modules.outputs: List<Album> sorted by year and title for AlbumGrid; updates after category changes.
modules.partners: Uses LokaleDatenbank.kategorienLaden(); AlbumGrid opens the details. The callback reloads this page first and then the parent view.
modules.lesson: A saved album ID may no longer be in the current cache. The total count and visible count can therefore differ.

modules.title: Edit multiple sort names conveniently
modules.job: Provides search, input fields, a change counter and saving. Manages controllers, focus changes and protection against leaving with unsaved changes.
modules.outputs: A list of changes passed to the callback; a Navigator result of true after successful saving. Cancelling does not return true.
modules.partners: HomePage supplies the rows and save function. KuenstlerSortierEntwurf keeps the domain logic separate from Flutter.
modules.lesson: If saving fails, the entered values remain on the page. Editing and accidental closing are blocked while saving.

modules.title: A reusable grid for child pages
modules.job: Displays album cards with a cover, title, artists and year. Tapping a card opens an AlbumDetailPage with the same services and callbacks.
modules.inputs: List<Album>, AuthService, optional country and two callbacks.
modules.outputs: Album grid and navigation to the detail page.
modules.partners: Used by KuenstlerPage and KategoriePage; builds AlbumCover. The main collection currently has its own grid in HomePage.
modules.lesson: Reuse is clearly visible here. It would be inaccurate to claim that every grid in the app already uses this widget.

modules.title: Load a cover file and handle image errors
modules.job: Requests a cover from the file cache and displays a loading indicator, a file image or a network image. A placeholder appears if the URL is missing or the network image fails.
modules.inputs: Album; changes to the ID or cover URL are detected when the widget is updated.
modules.outputs: Image display with FutureBuilder; no modified Album object.
modules.partners: Uses LokalerCoverCache.dateiFuer(), Image.file and Image.network as a fallback. Used in the main collection, AlbumGrid and the detail page.
modules.lesson: An existing file path does not guarantee that the image can be decoded. Image.file therefore also has error handling.

modules.title: Collect input and return results
modules.job: Groups three stateful dialogs: a category name, an individual artist adjustment and album category selection. Each dialog has its own input controllers or copy of the selection.
modules.inputs: Dialog title/initial name, artist data or categories with selected IDs.
modules.outputs: String, _KuenstlerDialogErgebnis or Set<int> through Navigator.pop(); null when cancelled.
modules.partners: HomePage and AlbumDetailPage open the dialogs and then save to SQLite themselves.
modules.lesson: The dialogs do not perform SQL operations. Controllers are released in dispose() of their own dialog state.

dependencies: Widgets, MaterialApp, Navigator, setState, ChangeNotifier and lifecycle.
Interactive TIDAL sign-in; supplies the initial token set to HomePage.
OpenAPI GET, token POST and cover downloads; interchangeable clients enable testing.
SQLite queries, migrations and transactions on the device.
Joins database and cover paths appropriately for the platform.
Secure platform storage for the JSON token package.
Passes album, track and video links to an external application.
Declared in the project; no CupertinoIcons call in the examined lib code.
Unit/widget tests, WidgetTester and the Flutter test environment.
Static style/analysis rules through analysis_options.yaml; not a runtime service.
Development tool for generating app icons; not a runtime service.
tests: Only changed IDs, fallback for empty values, stable filters/order, separate IDs despite identical names and invalid input.
Save/cancel, Android back navigation, save errors, preserved input, keyboard focus and different screen/text sizes.
Restoration, expiry time, shared refresh, network/server errors, invalid_grant, storage warning and exactly one 401 retry.
Start actions and touch targets, dynamic status values, restoration/forgetting sign-in and layout variants.
MemorySessionStore stores only in RAM, counts writes and simulates write errors; not an independent test case.
contracts: HTTP 200 is checked; the result is Json = Map<String, dynamic>.
Collection IDs are resolved using album, artist and cover resources.
Contains List<Album> and the next collection cursor, rather than the complete library.
Album list and storage timestamp; an empty table returns null.
Album/folder/lists plus the same TidalAuthService instance; no copied token.
Navigator.pop provides a result later; null usually means cancellation.
Only artists that have actually changed; after success, pop(true) returns to Home.
onKategorienGeaendert reports the change without a data-set payload; parents read again.
The listener reads the status getters again and calls setState; no app-wide event bus.
Image bytes remain in the file system. null/file errors lead to the network fallback.
Only the content ID is in the link; neither an OAuth token nor a music file is passed on.
storage: Albums, filtered views, loaded tracks, editor draft
Lost when the process ends; setState only updates the UI.
Categories, album assignments, artist preferences, metadata cache
Persistent within the app's storage area. Schema 3; no audio streams or tokens.
File name based on a sanitised album ID and a stable URL hash; can be downloaded again later.
Version, clientId, access/refresh tokens and expiry time as JSON
Encapsulated by TidalSessionStore; not in SQLite or cover files.
